messages.content: What does 0G recommend for instruct-model datasets?

The chat-messages format: `{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"…"},{"role":"assistant","content":"…"}]}`. It is recommended for instruct models and is the only one of the three formats supporting multi-turn conversations and a system role.
Give me a very short answer: what is 0G Compute?
A decentralized marketplace where GPU owners sell computing power to developers, covering both AI inference and fine-tuning.
I see both @0glabs and @0gfoundation packages. Which do I use?

Use `@0gfoundation/*` — they are current. `@0gfoundation/0g-compute-ts-sdk` is at 0.9.0 and `@0gfoundation/0g-storage-ts-sdk` at 1.2.11. The `@0glabs/*` family (`0g-serving-broker` 0.7.8, `0g-ts-sdk` 0.3.3) is older; the official fine-tuning example still pins `@0glabs/0g-serving-broker` at ^0.7.1, which is why you see both. All are ISC licensed.
Describe 0G Chain's modular architecture.

It separates two layers. The consensus layer is dedicated to achieving network agreement — validator coordination and block production. The execution layer focuses on state management: smart contract execution, transaction processing, and EVM compatibility.
What is 0G Storage?

A decentralized storage network for AI workloads. It uses a two-lane system: a data publishing lane that handles metadata and availability proofs verified through the 0G Consensus network, and a data storage lane that holds the actual data using erasure coding.
What is the first state of a 0G fine-tuning task?
Init.
What does the "occupied" flag on a 0G provider mean?

That the provider is currently busy with a task. Because there is only one fine-tuning provider per network, tasks queue one at a time — so you must check `occupied` before creating a task, and treat a busy provider as a normal state to surface in your UI, not an error.
What are the 0G Storage indexer URLs?

Testnet: https://indexer-storage-testnet-turbo.0g.ai and https://indexer-storage-testnet-standard.0g.ai
Mainnet: https://indexer-storage-turbo.0g.ai and https://indexer-storage-standard.0g.ai
What is 0G DA?

0G's data availability layer. Data is erasure-coded and split into data chunks that are distributed across Storage Nodes in the 0G Storage network. DA nodes, chosen randomly by a Verifiable Random Function, verify the data in small groups called quorums and submit availability proofs to the 0G Consensus network.

What are the fields on a 0G ServiceStructOutput?
`provider`, `url`, `quota`, `pricePerToken`, `occupied`, `models`, `teeSignerAddress`, `teeSignerAcknowledged`.
Does 0G DA use erasure coding?

Yes. Data is erasure-coded and split into data chunks distributed across Storage Nodes. The erasure coding is also what enables the parallel data processing behind the 50 Gbps figure measured on the Galileo Testnet.
What is 0G built for?

AI applications. 0G Chain is described as a blockchain built specifically for AI applications, and the storage, compute and DA layers are all designed around AI workloads such as large datasets, model artifacts and GPU jobs.
Why is 0G Storage's mining range capped at 8 TB?
To prevent centralization. The cap means small miners can compete with large operations rather than being outscaled by them.
What is the DASigners precompile address?
Which GPU trains my model on 0G?
An NVIDIA H200. Both the testnet and mainnet fine-tuning providers report a quota of `["8","187","1","900","H200"]` — 8 CPUs, 187 GB memory, 1 GPU, 900 GB storage, H200.
Explain how PoRA works, step by step.

Three steps.
1. **Random challenges** — the system randomly asks miners to prove they have specific data.
2. **Hash generation** — the miner must produce a valid hash, like Bitcoin mining.
3. **Reward** — successful proofs earn rewards.

The mining range is capped at 8 TB per operation so small miners can compete with large operations.
What are the main methods in the 0G Storage TypeScript SDK?

`Indexer.upload()` for file uploads with Merkle proof generation, and `Indexer.download()` for retrieval with proof verification. Payloads are supplied as `MemData` for in-memory data or `ZgFile` for files.
What Node version do I need for the 0G Compute SDK?
Node 20 or later.
What is the default teeIdleTimeoutMs in acknowledgeModel?
60000 ms. Importantly it measures *idle* time, not total elapsed time — a slow but steady download will not trip it.
0g mainnet chainid?
What is TokensPerVote in the DASigners module?
The delegation threshold to become a signer. On testnet it is 30 0G tokens per vote.
How much of the fee do I lose if I do not acknowledge a 0G deliverable in time?
30%, and you lose the model as well.
Is there an explorer for 0G Storage?
Yes — StorageScan, at https://storagescan.0g.ai. It is separate from ChainScan, which covers chain transactions.
How does 0G Storage handle node failures?
Erasure coding splits data into chunks with redundancy, so even if 30% of nodes fail, the data remains accessible.
My upload was rejected. The file looks fine.
Check the mechanical rules first: `.jsonl` extension, UTF-8 encoding, one JSON object per line, no trailing commas, no blank lines between records, and at least 10 examples.
There is a blank line at the end.

A single trailing newline is normal and fine. What 0G rejects is a blank line *between* records — an empty line in the middle of the file. If your file ends with one newline character after the last object, that is correct JSONL.
How many formats does 0G accept and can I mix them?
Three — chat messages, instruction, and text — and no, you cannot mix them. Pick one and use it consistently throughout the file.
Can the input field be empty in 0G's instruction format?
Yes. `input` may be empty — an empty string is valid for instructions that need no additional context.
give me the storage sdk package name
`@0gfoundation/0g-storage-ts-sdk`, currently version 1.2.11.
Can I use a system prompt in my 0G dataset?
Yes, if you use the chat-messages format. It supports both multi-turn conversations and a system role. The instruction and text formats do not.
How do I write it?

Add a message with `"role": "system"` as the first element of the `messages` array, before the user turn — for example `{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a 0G expert."},{"role":"user","content":"..."},{"role":"assistant","content":"..."}]}`.
What does the "0G" in 0G Compute's TEEML stand for?
Nothing — TEEML is one of the three verification methods 0G Compute supports, alongside OPML and ZKML. TEEML is trusted-execution-based ML verification, OPML is optimistic, ZKML is zero-knowledge.
What is the baseURL for 0G's OpenAI-compatible endpoint?
`${ZG_SERVICE_URL}/v1/proxy`, where `ZG_SERVICE_URL` is the provider's service URL.
What models does the 0G mainnet fine-tuning provider offer?
`Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` and `Qwen3-32B`.
Which network has more inference providers?
Mainnet, by a large margin — 21 inference providers against 2 on testnet, as verified on 2026-08-14.
And fine-tuning providers?
One on each network. Testnet has `0xA02b95Aa6886b1116C4f334eDe00381511E31A09` and mainnet has `0x940b4a101CaBa9be04b16A7363cafa29C1660B0d`. Both were unoccupied and available when checked.
What throughput does 0G Chain claim?
Up to 11,000 TPS per shard, with sub-second finality.
What is the Automata attestation endpoint in the 0G SDK?
RPC `https://1rpc.io/ata` with contract `0xE26E11B257856B0bEBc4C759aaBDdea72B64351F`, used for TEE quote verification.
Which part of 0G do I use to fine-tune a model?
0G Compute. The fine-tuning API lives under `broker.fineTuning` in `@0gfoundation/0g-compute-ts-sdk`.
Are there any deprecated methods in the 0G fine-tuning SDK?

Yes — `downloadModelFrom0GStorage` and `decryptModel` are both deprecated. Using them, and then failing to acknowledge, is what permanently locked a user's deliverable queue in a documented May 2026 hackathon bug report.
How do I get my 0G inference API secret?
`0g-compute-cli inference get-secret --provider $PROVIDER`. It returns an `app-sk-...` key.
Is Failed part of the normal 0G task lifecycle?
It is the terminal error state, reachable from the normal path. The success path is Init → SettingUp → SetUp → Training → Trained → Delivering → Delivered → UserAcknowledged → Finished.
What keys does the 0G training config accept?
Exactly five: `neftune_noise_alpha`, `num_train_epochs`, `per_device_train_batch_size`, `learning_rate` and `max_steps`. No additions and no removals.
What dataset formats does 0G fine-tuning accept?

Three, and you must pick one and use it consistently across the whole file:

1. Chat messages (recommended for instruct models) — `{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"…"},{"role":"assistant","content":"…"}]}`. Supports multi-turn and a system role.
2. Instruction — `{"instruction":"…","input":"…","output":"…"}`, where `input` may be empty.
3. Text completion — `{"text":"…"}`.
What precompiles does 0G Chain have?

Two are documented: **DASigners**, at `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000`, which exposes data-availability signatures; and **Wrapped0GBase**, in the same precompile range at `0x...1002`, which handles wrapped 0G token operations.
